# RFP ACT SACT 26-62

Request for Proposal for **Custodial Services**.

**Bid closing date**: Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, no later than **~~07 08~~ 22 September 2026, 0900 hours**, Eastern Daylight Time, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-62 Amendment #4**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026062_amdt4.pdf)

[**Price Proposal**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026062_pricing-2.xlsx) \| [**Annex B**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026062_annex-b.xlsx) \| [**Questions and Answers #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026062_qa1.pdf) \| [**Questions and Answers #2**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026062_qa2.pdf)
